name: LanDeng Chinese Incense Terminology (Chinese–English)
description: Canonical Chinese–English terminology for Chinese botanical incense, compiled by LanDeng (澜灯). Chinese terms are the source of truth; English is the agreed translation. One Chinese word does not always map to one English word.
